timing_design: 3 serial timing repetitions of exactly seed98001 and frozen recipes; 1 accuracy sample per case/method

exclusive_execution_evidence.interpretation: Recorded as exclusive_timing; runner launches one pinned fit process at a time. Continuous host load telemetry and CPU model are not present in this batch archive.

metrics_scope.regression: all train/val/test RMSE, converted by corresponding seed98001 y_scale for reporting
metrics_scope.multiclass: all train/val/test logloss, accuracy; matches prespecified worker, no new AUC metric

limitations: Same seed and same data repeated for timing; these are not three independent accuracy replicates.
Ratios describe selected operating points, not matched-error Pareto dominance or equal search budgets.

Timed fit/predict are worker API calls including indexed input slicing; exclude process startup, imports, model construction, preprocessing, model inspection, metric calculation, and hyperparameter search.
Each test prediction timing covers the complete same-case held-out batch; no cross-case equal-row comparison is implied.
PL and LinXGBoost retain author adapter/native dependency semantics; observed ratios do not isolate algorithmic complexity from implementation/API cost.
Host exclusivity is supported by the plan and serial pinned execution record; no independent continuous load trace or CPU-model record is available in the batch archive.
